title: CI Deep Dive: Build Intelligence 360
subtitle: Everything CI in one place: throughput, duration percentiles and outliers, failure forensics, flaky pipelines and MTTR, repositories/branches/commits, developers and triggers, build infrastructure and cost proxies, pipeline and template inventory, and security scans / policy evaluations correlated to CI executions.

widget.text: Every CI execution, stage, step, failure, repository, commit, developer, build machine, pipeline, template, security scan and policy evaluation in one place. Use the filters (Organization, Project, Pipeline, Repository, Branch, Status, Trigger Type, Infrastructure, OS) to slice every widget, the date picker to change the window (KPIs compare to the previous period), and the tabs below to go deeper. Tables link straight to the execution in Harness. Notes: ~half of executions have no repository/branch (manual runs without a codebase); queue time and CPU/memory utilisation are not reported by this account, so cost uses build minutes and CI credits.

widget.title: Organization & Project Scorecard

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    pe.orgidentifier as organization,
    pe.projectidentifier as project,
    count() as builds,
    round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) over (), 1) as share_pct,
    round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate,
    count(case when pe.status = "FAILED" then 1 end) as failed,
    distinct_count(pe.pipelineidentifier) as pipelines,
    round(median(pe.build_duration) / 1000.0, 0) as median_duration,
    round(sum(pe.build_duration) / 3600000.0, 2) as ci_hours
  }
| group_by organization, project
| order_by builds desc

widget.subtitle: Grouped by organization: volume, share of total, reliability, speed and CI hours per project

widget.title: Weekly Build Time Percentiles

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate} | filter pe.build_duration > 0
| aggregate {
    date_trunc("week", pe.startts) as week,
    round(median(pe.build_duration) / 60000.0, 2) as p50_minutes,
    round(avg(pe.build_duration) / 60000.0, 2) as avg_minutes,
    round(percentile(pe.build_duration, 90) / 60000.0, 2) as p90_minutes
  }
| group_by week | order_by week asc

widget.subtitle: P50, mean and P90 build minutes per week; a widening gap means growing tail latency

widget.title: Build Time Distribution

queries.query:

| aggregate {

queries.query:

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution_failure" f | inner join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe on pe.planexecutionid = f.plan_execution_id
| filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate} | filter f.failure_message is not null and f.failure_message not in ['""', ""]

widget.title: Commit-Level History

queries.query:
with c as (
  find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate} | filter pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_id is not null and pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_id not in ["NA", ""]
  | select {
      pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_id as commit_id, pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_message as message,
      pe.moduleinfo_author_id as author, pe.moduleinfo_repository as repository, pe.moduleinfo_branch_name as branch,
      pe.orgidentifier as org, pe.projectidentifier as project, pe.pipelineidentifier as pipeline,
      pe.planexecutionid as exec_id, pe.status as status, pe.startts as started, pe.build_duration as bd,
      row_number() over (partition by pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_id order by pe.startts desc) as rn,
      count() over (partition by pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_id) as runs,
      sum(case when pe.status = "FAILED" then 1 else 0 end) over (partition by pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_id) as failed_runs
    }
)
find c | filter rn = 1
| select { started, commit_id, message, author, repository, branch, runs, failed_runs, status,
    round(bd / 1000.0, 0) as last_duration, exec_id, org, project, pipeline }
| order_by started desc | limit 100

widget.subtitle: One row per commit: reruns, failures, latest status; click the execution id for the latest run

find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate} | filter pe.moduleinfo_author_id is not null and pe.moduleinfo_author_id not in ["NA", ""]
| aggregate { pe.moduleinfo_author_id as developer,
    count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) as successful,
    count(case when pe.status != "SUCCESS" then 1 end) as unsuccessful }
| group_by developer | order_by successful desc | limit 12

widget.subtitle: Builds per commit author split by outcome

widget.title: Developer Scorecard

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate} | filter pe.moduleinfo_author_id is not null and pe.moduleinfo_author_id not in ["NA", ""]
| aggregate {
    pe.moduleinfo_author_id as developer,
    count() as builds,
    round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) over (), 1) as share_pct,
    round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate,
    distinct_count(pe.moduleinfo_repository) as repositories,
    distinct_count(pe.pipelineidentifier) as pipelines,
    distinct_count(pe.moduleinfo_branch_commit_id) as commits,
    round(avg(pe.build_duration) / 1000.0, 0) as avg_duration,
    max(pe.startts) as last_build
  }
| group_by developer | order_by builds desc

widget.subtitle: Leaderboard with share of all builds (window function) and reliability

widget.title: Trigger Catalog

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:pipeline_execution" x | inner join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe on pe.planexecutionid = x.plan_execution_id
| filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    x.trigger_type as trigger_type,
    coalesce(nullif(nullif(x.trigger_name, ""), "NA"), "(manual run)") as trigger_name,
    coalesce(nullif(x.triggered_by_identifier, ""), "unknown") as triggered_by,
    count() as runs,
    distinct_count(pe.pipelineidentifier) as pipelines,
    round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate,
    max(pe.startts) as last_run
  }
| group_by trigger_type, trigger_name, triggered_by | order_by runs desc | limit 40

widget.title: Infrastructure Matrix

queries.query:
find view "ci:dim_infrastructure__ci" i | inner join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe on pe.planexecutionid = i.plan_execution_id
| inner join view "ci:stage_execution_summary_ci_table" ct on ct.stageexecutionid = i.stage_execution_id
| filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    i.host as hosting, i.type as infra_type, i.os as os, i.architecture as arch,
    coalesce(nullif(i.resource_class, ""), "n/a") as resource_class,
    distinct_count(pe.planexecutionid) as builds,
    count() as stages,
    round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate,
    round(avg(i.build_multiplier), 1) as multiplier,
    round(sum(ct.stagebuildtime) / 60000.0, 1) as build_minutes,
    round(sum(ct.stagebuildtime * ct.buildmultiplier) / 60000.0, 1) as weighted_minutes
  }
| group_by hosting, infra_type, os, arch, resource_class | order_by weighted_minutes desc

queries.query:
with sc as (find view "view:sto:scan" s | aggregate { s.plan_execution_id as spx, count() as scans } | group_by spx)
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate} | left join sc on sc.spx = pe.planexecutionid
| aggregate { date_trunc("week", pe.startts) as week,
    case when sc.spx is null then "Not scanned" else "Scanned" end as security, count() as builds }
| group_by week, security | order_by week asc

widget.title: Governance Coverage by Pipeline

queries.query:
with sc as (find view "view:sto:scan" s | aggregate { s.plan_execution_id as spx, count() as scans } | group_by spx), op as (find view "opa:policy_evaluation_result_view" o | aggregate { o.plan_execution_id as opx, count() as evals, count(case when o.policy_status != "pass" then 1 end) as policy_fails } | group_by opx)
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate} and ${branch_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${trigger_filter_predicate}
| left join sc on sc.spx = pe.planexecutionid
| left join op on op.opx = pe.planexecutionid
| aggregate {
    pe.projectidentifier as project, pe.pipelineidentifier as pipeline,
    count() as builds,
    round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate,
    count(sc.spx) as scanned_builds,
    round(100.0 * count(sc.spx) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as scan_coverage,
    coalesce(sum(sc.scans), 0) as scans,
    count(op.opx) as policy_checked_builds,
    round(100.0 * count(op.opx) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as policy_coverage,
    coalesce(sum(op.policy_fails), 0) as policy_failures
  }
| group_by project, pipeline | order_by builds desc | limit 60

widget.subtitle: Three-way correlation per pipeline: CI health x STO scan coverage x OPA policy coverage
